notes: Candidates from exploratory GitHub scouting; not installed, executed, independently benchmarked or adopted.
Relative priority is a proposed evaluation sequence, not project authority.
Use exact pinned upstream versions and project-owned independent baselines when work resumes.
Do not put private repository source, secrets, sensitive investigation data or unpublished vulnerability details in public indexes.

first_wave.task: Archive permitted sources and inspect file metadata; preserve original hashes and claims/editorial boundaries
first_wave.baseline: Nocturnal current source capture, verified journal and local metadata inspection
first_wave.acceptance: Source bytes, custody/journal linkage, permission and planted metadata contradiction; no invented source truth

first_wave.task: Independent PV time-series quality, physical-model baseline and negative controls
first_wave.baseline: Policy Lab existing source QA and E7/PVDAQ evidence decisions
first_wave.acceptance: Held-out quality flags, scientific parity, false admission, false rejection, exact unchanged domain decisions

first_wave.baseline: Cite-Agent existing claim grounder and equal-access standalone agent
first_wave.acceptance: Correct supported/contradicted/unsupported determinations, exact quote/source, refusal when uncertain, measured cost

later_wave.task: Portable reproducible evidence package and rights preservation
Entity-document case exchange with no unsupported promotion
Compare audited case custody; optional architecture reference
Repository structure and change impact comparison; assess AGPL obligations

unverified_candidates.reason: GitHub repository path did not resolve; do not present as available

freeze_rule: No activity until explicit resume request
